info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Facility Site Administration-spec
info.description: The Facility Site Administration API facilitates the management and configuration of facility sites within the banking system. This endpoint allows authorized users to create new facility site records, ensuring that essential site information is captured and maintained accurately. Typical consumers of this API include banking administrators and facility managers looking to streamline site operations and enhance administrative oversight. By utilizing this API, organizations can improve facility management efficiency and ensure compliance with relevant regulations.
